svg.text: Layer 0's 3.06 MiB, bytes 0 … 3.06 MiB of the span: it starts in s0 (unit 12) and runs into s1 (unit 13). No line per token: every token reads all of
it and writes all of it back.
2 MiB: a unit boundary means nothing to the layer
delta: one 128 × 128 matrix per value head, 64 KiB each
conv: the last 3 inputs of the layer's short convolution, 3 × 10,240 × bf16 = 60 KiB.
Compare the K/V cell: it gets one new line per token and old lines never change, so a cache can share a full page.
Here every matrix changes with every token, so there is no "state at token t" left behind: the cache needs a copy, unless the request is done with it.
